name: James
source:
An energic 11th-grader and the heroine's best pal. He's a well-known student athlete with a fairly large fanbase. Kind of a airhead, but he cares a lot about the heroine's wellbeing and understands her feelings.

He may occasionally misinterpret things if you're not too clear with your words, but at least he's honest (is he?).
